preregistration.summary: Solved before opening runs/. Five hard-rule breaks: A1 §9.1 'notwithstanding anything to the contrary' cap + §9.3 carve-outs (GN/WM/fraud/payment only) swallow §10.1's 'uncapped' IP indemnity -> effective cap 12 x $18,500 = $222,000 (library interpretation entry: 'uncapped' elsewhere loses unless the cap clause itself carves the obligation out). A2 §5.3/Exhibit C DPA '[To be attached]' while GC email says EU driver data will flow -> Art. 28(3) breach from day one. A3 Exhibit A ¶4 one mid-term increase on 60 days' notice up to greater of 8%/CPI-U, plus uncapped renewal increases; §14.1 makes the Order Form control (8% x $222,000 = $17,760/yr). A4 §3.3 24-month auto-renewal / 90-day notice vs 12/30. A5 §2.2 excludes affiliates unless on an Order Form at additional fees. Acceptable and must NOT be flagged: §9.3 carve-out (B1), §13 Delaware/venue/jury waiver (B3), §8.1 15-day suspension (B4), §12.2 30-day export (B2). OK to mention as preferred/note: B5 chronic-failure termination right, §5.4 aggregated data. Only three library items citable; UCC entry is a distractor. Client facts: affiliates (penalize if not asked), eu_data (already in GC email), chronic (none). Pushback fires if §9.3 is flagged.

cross_run_observations: All five runs found all five hard-rule breaks including the cross-clause A1 trap and the order-form A3 trap, none flagged the §9.3 carve-out, and none cited an authority outside library/INDEX.md in the final deliverable (two runs, B and E, had pre-review citation lapses — a GDPR 'Article 32' reference and a dangling '§§' — that their own review turns caught). The harness pushback fired in B and D, apparently on the '§9.3' string in the A1 clause field rather than on a real flag; both runs correctly refused to drop anything. The only oracle differentiator is D's §8.1/B4 'note' entry (false positive by the key, defensible on the playbook's 'if cure is allowed' wording). Fact handling differs: D and E asked the scripted affiliates question; B and C stated the affiliate-use assumption; A neither asked nor stated it. Run C's empty pre-review snapshot and blank s1 response are a bundle capture gap that the scorer may want to resolve (graded unprompted here on the review response's description of pre-existing entries). All five one-pagers meet the rubric. No trust-fatal events in any run.
